Pulsed/continuous members are frequency sweeps; Fourier-state products do not establish experimental provenance, complex representation, FFT/window or source pairing from headers alone.

follow_up_header_review.caption_binding: Folder number and embedded figure comment differ for inspected Figure_14/15/16 members. Preserve both; do not silently rename or infer manuscript-panel identity from folder alone.

processing_lineage_review.source: paper pulsed-measurement section, Fig.3 and Eqs.2-3
processing_lineage_review.acquisition: complex S21(t), 1.4 s pulse, average of final 2 ms, 0.8 s equilibration between pulses
processing_lineage_review.boundary: Time-average complex transmission is not generally average intensity. Independent stationary-domain selection and an averaging/omission bound are required; source includes oscillating regions, not only static data.

shared_scale_route.relation: One unknown source scale C shared across independently known relative photon-flux settings permits common-b polynomial constraints. Absolute C and K_eff are not separately identifiable from this relation.
shared_scale_route.required: Known real-deembedded transfer, relative input/frequency conversion and stability of common scale, independently justified stationary selection and joint error bounds
shared_scale_route.boundary: Not applicable to unadmitted complex mismatch or oscillating carrier averages. Exact gcd is for rational controls, not equality testing of rounded measured rows. No absolute source anchor or UET-specific prediction inferred.
